prompts.master:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production RGBA game character master sprite sheet for the existing Demian game.
Input 1 is the identity/costume reference photo of Amin (the man standing in a teal polo); input 2 is ONLY the existing game's art style, layout and proportions reference. Make a NEW character Amin, recognizable from input 1, matching input 2's polished compact chibi rendering with softly painted surfaces and clear dark edges.
Identity LOCKS: thick short upward black hair, broad oval face, thick eyebrows, dark eyes, light short stubble (NOT a full beard), medium warm skin, stocky build, plain emerald/teal green short sleeve polo with collar and buttons, dark charcoal gray jeans, black shoes, silver metal wristwatch on LEFT wrist. No other people. No wings, no pet, no logos, no graphic on shirt. His hands must leave his pockets during movement.
Technical output: landscape 1536 x 1024 if possible. EXACTLY 32 completely isolated full-body sprites in EXACTLY 4 rows and 8 evenly spaced columns, transparent background, no shadows or colored backing. Generous transparent gaps between every silhouette, no touching sprites, no cropped hair/hands/feet, one coherent identity and costume throughout. Consistent head/body proportions (head about 40 percent full height), adult character transformed into game's chibi style.
Row 1: 8-direction turnaround, sequential front (south), southwest, west, northwest, back (north), northeast, east, southeast. Feet grounded.
Row 2: eight subtle breathing/blinking idle poses facing three-quarter right; full standing height throughout.
Row 3: eight sequential jump poses facing right: anticipation, push off, rising, apex with legs mildly bent (keep most of full standing height), descending, landing, recover, standing. Final pose fully upright same height as idle. No smear effects.
Row 4: eight friendly greeting/celebration poses facing right: neutral, raises hand, wave, hand to chest respectful greeting, cheerful raised hand, lowers hand, neutral, neutral. Keep head, torso and legs consistent.
No text, no grid lines, no labels, no background, no ground plane, no props. Real transparent alpha. Preserve Amin's face and teal polo; do not copy the bearded black-shirted style-reference character.
prompts.motion:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent RGBA animation source sprite sheet for Amin in Demian.
Input 1 is the APPROVED Amin character master sheet: LOCK his exact face, large chibi head, stocky torso, upward thick black hair, light stubble, plain teal/emerald green short-sleeve polo, charcoal gray jeans, black shoes, silver LEFT wristwatch. Input 2 is his real identity reference. No full beard, no glasses, wings, pets, effects, props or logos.
Create a NEW coherent motion sheet with EXACTLY 32 isolated full-body poses: 8 columns by 4 rows, landscape 1536x1024, transparent background, generous gaps, NO touching silhouettes or cut-off body parts. Same head size, same body volume and costume in every pose; softly shaded cartoon edges matching input 1. Every pose faces right / three-quarter right. Each silhouette must be continuous.
Row 1: eight sequential full natural WALK cycle key poses with contralateral arms and legs, grounded feet alternating, mostly upright; all standing silhouettes same height, no crouching.
Row 2: eight sequential natural RUN cycle key poses with opposite arms/legs, moderate running stride, small knee bends, minimal torso lean; retain FULL STANDING BODY HEIGHT (no tiny squashed running figures), head same size as row 1. Distinct left and right foot phases. No airborne extreme tuck.
Row 3: eight LAND/recover key poses: first fully standing, second knees slightly soft, third and fourth absorb landing with a shallow knee bend, fifth recover, last three fully standing. Keep face and scale identical.
Row 4: eight low FEET-FIRST SLIDE poses, legs extended forward RIGHT, torso reclined backward, hips almost at floor, one hand braced behind, face upright looking right. Head the same size as standing poses, total slide silhouette height around HALF standing height, and width less than each column width. Entire extended shoes and bracing hand visible with margins; no squashing of head or torso. Vary free arm and foot subtly for loop.
No letters, no numbers, no labels, no grid lines, no floor, no scenery, no shadows, no brown backing, actual transparent alpha.

preparation: Deterministic component extraction, uniform per-clip scale calibration, grounded foot pivot and existing V14 single-owner interpolation.
